---
title: "Model performance comparison plots"
author: "Michael Krochta"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

Compare global and local model RMSE for full and partial predictor sets.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggh4x)
```

## Load model results

```{r load_metrics}
project_dir <- "C:/Users/mbkro/OneDrive/Documents/wetland-ml-models"
fig_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures")

path_global_ml <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "metrics_overall_revised.csv")
path_global_lme <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "lme_metrics_overall_revised.csv")
path_local <- file.path(project_dir, "results", "local_results",
                        "local_models_summary_common_dates_revised.csv")

input_paths <- c(path_global_ml, path_global_lme, path_local)
missing_paths <- input_paths[!file.exists(input_paths)]
if (length(missing_paths)) {
  stop("Missing input files:\n", paste(missing_paths, collapse = "\n"))
}

g_ml <- read_csv(path_global_ml, show_col_types = FALSE)
g_lme <- read_csv(path_global_lme, show_col_types = FALSE)
loc <- read_csv(path_local, show_col_types = FALSE)

required_global <- c("response", "set", "alg", "RMSE")
required_local <- c("Site", "Metric", "Set", "Model", "RMSE")
stopifnot(
  all(required_global %in% names(g_ml)),
  all(required_global %in% names(g_lme)),
  all(required_local %in% names(loc))
)

response_labels <- c(max = "Max WT", mean = "Mean WT", range = "Range WT")

glob_all <- bind_rows(
  g_ml %>% transmute(response = tolower(response), set = toupper(set),
                     alg = toupper(alg), RMSE),
  g_lme %>% transmute(response = tolower(response), set = toupper(set),
                      alg = "GLS", RMSE)
) %>%
  mutate(
    response = unname(response_labels[response]),
    alg = factor(alg, levels = c("GLS", "RFR", "XGB"))
  )

loc_all <- loc %>%
  transmute(
    Site = as.character(Site),
    response = unname(response_labels[tolower(Metric)]),
    set = toupper(Set),
    alg = factor(toupper(Model), levels = c("GLS", "RFR", "XGB")),
    RMSE
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(glob_all[, c("response", "set", "alg", "RMSE")]),
  !anyNA(loc_all[, c("Site", "response", "set", "alg", "RMSE")]),
  all(is.finite(glob_all$RMSE)),
  all(is.finite(loc_all$RMSE)),
  nrow(glob_all) == 18L,
  nrow(loc_all) == 126L,
  n_distinct(loc_all$Site) == 7L,
  !anyDuplicated(glob_all[c("response", "set", "alg")]),
  !anyDuplicated(loc_all[c("Site", "response", "set", "alg")])
)
```

## Global and local model performance

```{r plot_combined}
alg_levels <- c("LM", "RFR", "XGB")

glob_combined <- glob_all %>%
  mutate(
    alg = recode(as.character(alg), "GLS" = "LM", "LME" = "LM"),
    alg = factor(alg, levels = alg_levels),
    set = factor(set, levels = c("A", "B"), labels = c("Full", "Partial"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(response, set, alg) %>%
  summarise(RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

loc_combined <- loc_all %>%
  mutate(
    alg = recode(as.character(alg), "GLS" = "LM", "LME" = "LM"),
    alg = factor(alg, levels = alg_levels),
    set = factor(set, levels = c("A", "B"), labels = c("Full", "Partial"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(Site, response, set, alg) %>%
  summarise(RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ylims_by_resp <- bind_rows(
  glob_all %>% select(response, RMSE),
  loc_all %>% select(response, RMSE)
) %>%
  group_by(response = as.character(response)) %>%
  summarise(ymin = 0, ymax = max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(ymax = max(pretty(c(0, ymax))))

ylims_df <- expand_grid(
  response = unique(ylims_by_resp$response),
  alg = factor(alg_levels, levels = alg_levels),
  set = c("Full", "Partial")
) %>%
  left_join(ylims_by_resp, by = "response") %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ymin, ymax), names_to = "which", values_to = "RMSE")

site_pal <- c(
  Anvil = "#E67E80", Butte = "#8AADF4", Cooper = "#A6D189",
  Crater = "#C6A0F6", Hideaway = "#7DC4E4", Pint = "#E5C890", Sam = "#F4B8E4"
)

p_combined <- ggplot() +
  geom_blank(data = ylims_df, aes(x = alg, y = RMSE)) +
  geom_line(
    data = loc_combined,
    aes(x = alg, y = RMSE, group = interaction(Site, set), color = Site),
    linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = loc_combined,
    aes(x = alg, y = RMSE, color = Site),
    size = 2.4
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = glob_combined,
    aes(x = alg, y = RMSE, group = response, linetype = "Global (overall)"),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = glob_combined,
    aes(x = alg, y = RMSE, shape = "Global (overall)"),
    color = "black", fill = "white", stroke = 1.1, size = 2.8
  ) +
  facet_grid2(set ~ response, scales = "free_y", axes = "margins") +
  facetted_pos_scales(
    y = list(
      set == "Full" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), breaks = 0:3),
      set == "Partial" ~ scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 3), breaks = 0:3)
    )
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = site_pal, name = "Site", drop = FALSE) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("Global (overall)" = "dashed"), guide = "legend") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Global (overall)" = 21), guide = "legend") +
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(title = NULL, override.aes = list(color = "black")),
    shape = guide_legend(title = NULL,
                         override.aes = list(color = "black", fill = "white", size = 3)),
    color = guide_legend(title = "Site")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Algorithm", y = "RMSE (°C)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

outfile <- file.path(fig_dir, "local_vs_global_RMSE_Combined_Full_Partial_revised.png")
ggsave(outfile, p_combined, width = 11, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
